description: Arrêts et lignes du réseau bus-tram Irigo is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by RD Angers. Arrêts et lignes du réseau bus-tram Irigo de Angers Loire Métropole Ce jeu de données a pour source les quatre fichiers (trips, routes, stops, stopstimes) des données du réseau au format GTFS disponible ici: Angers Loire Métropole - Réseau Irigo - GTFS Chaque ligne du dataset correspond à un arrêt par lignes de bus ou ... Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are gtfs, irigo. The portal shows 5,306 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
